summary: RED phase for task 1.1 (slugify basic form + unicode transliteration). Added tests/test_slug.py with 6 tests, each tagged @pytest.mark.l4(<criterion id>): 1 for C-540dbbf7 (Hello World -> hello-world), 1 for C-968f19f6 ('  Hello,   World!! ' -> hello-world), 2 for C-dc5ae7cf (pytest.raises(ValueError) for '' and '!!!'), 1 for C-2d8e9905 (Creme Brulee -> creme-brulee), 1 for C-c5654742 (Cafe Tokyo -> cafe). Verified the second RED property by temporarily swapping the stub body to `return None` and re-running: all 6 fail as assertion failures (4 AssertionError on the equality checks, 2 'DID NOT RAISE ValueError'), then the stub was restored to `raise NotImplementedError` and re-verified. No existing test was modified, deleted or weakened; no protected files (openspec/**, tasks.md, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, opencode.json, AGENTS.md) touched; no commits or git config changes.
